SDLI1.label: Login issues

SDLI1.1.label: Entitlement issues
SDLI1.1.description: Definition: Use when the user can identify their account but the expected access is not linked to it, or the user has not subscribed

SDLI1.2.label: User blocked due to cache and cookies issues
SDLI1.2.description: Definition: Use when stored cookies or sessions prevent login or keep the user in the wrong account.

SDLI1.3.label: Browser compatibility issues
SDLI1.3.description: Definition: Use when login fails only in a specific browser, device or browser version.

SDLI1.4.label: Not enough info
SDLI1.4.description: Definition: Use when the user cannot log in but no likely cause is provided.

SDLI1.5.label: Other
SDLI1.5.description: Definition: Use for another personal account login issue not listed above.

SDLI1.6.label: AI Trial access guidance
SDLI1.6.description: Definition: Use when the user needs instructions to activate or access an AI trial.

SDLI1.7.label: Wrong account unexpected account switching
SDLI1.7.description: Definition: Use when there's a mismatch between personal and instutitional account or one is overriding the other one

SDLI1.8.label: Password reset email not received
SDLI1.8.description: Definition: Use when the password reset message does not arrive / spam / junk / not found

SDLI1.9.label: Activation verification link issue
SDLI1.9.description: Definition: Use when an activation, verification or one-time link is missing, invalid or not working.

SDLI1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified as 'Login issues'. Choose the root cause from this group only. That contact reason means: Use when an individual user cannot sign in to or activate their Elsevier account, with signals such as password, reset email, verification or activation link, one-time link, wrong account, account switching, cookies or browser issues, and not for institutional SSO failures.
